description: Source code for the DiskBlockObjectWriter class in Apache Spark, responsible for writing JVM objects directly to disk, managing file streams, serialization, checksums, and partial write recovery.

classes.name: DiskBlockObjectWriter
classes.description: A class for writing JVM objects directly to disk, supporting appending, partial write recovery, and serialization.

methods.name: setChecksum
methods.description: Sets the checksum algorithm for the output stream.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes file output streams, channel, and checksum streams.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the writer, initializing streams if necessary.

methods.name: closeResources
methods.description: Closes and cleans up all open resources and streams.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the writer and commits remaining data.

methods.name: commitAndGet
methods.description: Flushes, commits, and returns the file segment of written data.

methods.name: revertPartialWritesAndClose
methods.description: Reverts uncommitted writes by truncating the file.

methods.name: closeAndDelete
methods.description: Closes the writer, deletes the file, and resets metrics.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a key-value pair to the output stream.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes raw bytes to the output stream.

methods.name: recordWritten
methods.description: Updates metrics after writing a record.

methods.name: updateBytesWritten
methods.description: Reports the number of bytes written to the metrics.
